name: Nine Heavens Boat
description: Legend has it that in ancient China, Fuxi built a large ship to lead humans to escape from flood-stricken areas. Therefore, the boat can go up to the sky and into the water, go to any place in China's Jiuzhou, and lead humans to seek freedom and happiness, hence the name "Jiuzhou". Pinku recreates the legendary Fuxi Ship and creates China's "Noah's Ark".
